_source: heroes.exe 0x71938, the computer's tile value function, and 0x6e950, its battle estimate (decoded 2026-10-03, data/knowledge_base/research/ai-planner-decodes.md). Values are in gold equivalents: a resource times its worth (data/ai/buy_choice.json resource_worth), an army rating times the player's army value f9.
_mode0_cap: 0x733a9: the potential's tile values (mode 0) are kept within +-mode0_cap before they are cached; the planner's modes 1 and 2 are not.

hero_weight._comment: Hero float +0xb2, set each AI turn: plain army rating x per_rating + base. Scales stat boosters and the battle experience term.

_supported_dwellings: The support factor (data/ai/planner.json support) scales every tile case but an own town, a stack worth less than nothing, and the paid dwellings, which clear data 0x32088; of those only the goblins' Straw Hut (0x72cbc) keeps it.
_boat: Cell class 190 (0x73242): a free boat is worth a flat 100. Shipyard purchases write the class into the cell (0x7748c).

boosters._comment: hero weight x value; 0 once this hero has visited.

artifact._comment: Free: the artifact's value A (buy_choice.json artifact_values). Guarded: trunc(A x P + battle value) against guard_count stacks of guard_unit. Paid: max(0, trunc(A - price x gold worth)). Unknown encounter: free_share A + guarded_share G + paid_share P.

mine._comment: Daily yield x worth x the tile's income days, x the owner multiplier of the computer's level (owner_multiplier) when another player holds it. Income days start at days and drop near other players' heroes: within box tiles of one, min(days, |manhattan - offset| / divisor).

_comment_guarded_sites: Graveyard and shipwreck (0x72df5): per band, trunc(reward x P + battle value) against the band's guard, reward = gold x gold worth + the average artifact value when an artifact comes with it. The bands are the catalog's own outcomes (the original's table: 1000, 2000, 5000 and 2000 + artifact gold against 5 stacks of 2, 3, 5 and 10 ghosts); an unrolled site counts the bands by weight.

obelisk._comment: trunc(trunc(ultimate artifact value / divisor x pieces / obelisks) x (base - |center - revealed pieces| / pieces)) x (b5 + b5_offset); 0 once visited.

town._comment: Worth of a town not the player's own: sum of its building values (buy_choice.json buildings) + gold worth x gold + extra; when a player owns it, x owner multiplier x (owned_base + owned_per_missing x (players_max - players)). Value = trunc(worth x P + battle value).

home._comment: A trip to an own castle, the rebalance routine's evaluate mode (0x746d8): ((1 + gap + offset)^2 - 1) x f9 x (hero + garrison rating) x weaker (hero weaker than the garrison) or stronger.

battle._comment: 0x6e950. Am, Dm = plain ratings (the original's count brackets and hero skill terms, 0x73d34, are not ported). Siege: Dm x siege. Neutral defender: Am x (neutral_base + neutral_per_level x AI level). Human defender: Dm x human_defender. P = Am^e / (Am^e + Dm^e) with the pessimism rows in adventure_ai.json battle_estimate. Value = -own loss x (loss_base - b1)^2, + enemy loss x owner multiplier x (b1 + gain_offset)^2 for a player defender, x f9; an attacking hero adds -(artifacts + attacker_risk) x (1 - P) + xp_share x XP x P x hero weight, XP = defenders' hit points + hero_xp for a defending hero; a defending hero adds (artifacts + defender_prize) x owner multiplier x P.

rating._comment: 0x73d34, the computer's army rating. Each stack: count x rating x (1 + bracket), the bracket by count (the first row whose 'above' the count exceeds); shooters, sprites and rogues get x shooter of the bracket, griffins x griffin. With a hero: x skill[attack + defense + 20] (0..40), x (morale + 48) / 48 above 0 or (morale + 24) / 24 below, x (luck + 16) / 16; combat spells add value x power factor x charges[charges] each, capped at cap_share x the best one, then against the army A: above twice A -> high x A, above 1.5 A -> A, above A -> low x A. A siege tower adds tower_per_k x (5 + 4 dwellings + other buildings), x skill, then above twice A -> 1.5 A, above 1.5 A -> 1.25 A, above A -> 0.9 A.

owner_multiplier._comment: Set each AI turn from the computer's level (player byte +0x12): level 1 human 0.6, computer 1.3; level 2 both 1.0; otherwise human 1 + human_per_level x level, computer computer_base - computer_per_level x level.

shrine._comment: 0x728d7: the spell's value (rating.spell_values; adventure spells from extra_values, data 0x1f17c) x (charges curve at knowledge - at the charges held), x rating.skill[knowledge] for power-scaled spells. Needs a spell book and knowledge above 0.

hero_odds._comment: Another player's hero (0x71f1e). In the planner's modes (1 and 2) a human's hero worth more than human_above counts human_factor times. In mode 0 (the potential's) below worse_below the value is x (3 - 2P), below worst_below also x (2 - 2P). A hero in his town adds the town's worth x (1 + owned_per_missing x (players_max - players) x owner multiplier) x P, without the owned-town factor (0.9 + ...).

monster_join._comment: A stack that offers to join (cell byte 9 bit 0x80) and that the hero's rating with skills (0x73d34) beats by join_ratio: join_share x its recruit value (0 without room) + battle_share x battle value.
